incidents.name: Game newBidEtherMin logic error
incidents.notes: Game.newBidEtherMin() computed the minimum next bid wrongly, so makeBid()'s `require(msg.value > newBidEtherMin())` could be satisfied with a near-zero bid while the contract refunded the previous bidder in full, draining its ETH.

sources.ref: onchain review: Game 0x52d69c67536f55efefe02941868e5e762538dbd6 created 2024-02-12T10:39:35Z by 0x28d808550ed0a9a15bd3b9103664b8c12abfa740, unrelated to the attack sender; no EIP-1967 events, age from deployment - only 30,732 seconds (8.5 hours) old at the incident. ~20 ETH x $2,628.59 at incidentTimestamp 1707765107 (DefiLlama) = $52,572.
